slots.name: dates
slots.sentence: The conference runs from 6 to 8 October at Jerusalem’s International Convention Center.

slots.name: Israeli speakers
slots.sentence: From Israel, the program lists Bezalel Smotrich, the finance minister, self-declared “fascist homophobe” and internationally sanctioned extremist, and Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu, who in 2023 called for an atom bomb to be dropped on Gaza and was earlier ordered to face disciplinary proceedings for racist incitement against Palestinians.

slots.name: co-sponsors
slots.sentence: The conference’s co-sponsors include the Sovereignty Movement and Regavim, the organisation Smotrich founded.

slots.name: event producer
slots.sentence: The ultranationalist Israeli television news outlet Channel 14 says it is producing the event with Hazony’s foundation and his Herzl Institute.
